steve.voice: earnest, polite to a fault; clean mid voice, tidy even rhythm, small range

lorna.voice: sunny optimist; warm sing-song, wide melodic glides, bright laugh

kit.voice: fast talker, bright and clicky, little stumbles (repeats a syllable)

dottie.voice: grandmotherly crossing guard; tremulous, breathy, slower, warm chuckle, a little creak

theo.voice: night-shift nurse; low, soft, breathy, small range, grateful sighs, dry

pippa.voice: 9-year-old lemonade critic; high, bouncy, big range, "ooh!" and giggles

rocco.voice: chatty mail carrier; low chesty voice, quick, never grumpy, big hearty laugh

wren.voice: quiet poet; very breathy and soft, slow, tiny range, thoughtful "hm"

variants.greet: rise-fall hello (customer arrives); t1 "hey-ya", t2 "hel-lo!", t3 drawn "hiii!" + tag
variants.happy: bright, higher, laughs (great order); t1/t2 babble+laugh, t3 "yay!"+giggle, t4 "mm! oh!" run
variants.unhappy: gentle soft, never sulky - ends on a hopeful lift; t1 "aww... mm", t2 "oh... hm?", t3 "aw, mm-hm"
variants.goodbye: t1 descending "bye-bye", t2 "see-ya!", t3 rising-settling "bye-bye" (+hum for Theo/Wren/Dottie)

loudness: Normalized 2026-10-23 (QA PR#20 pass) by assets/audio/src/normalize_pr20.py: integrated LUFS (BS.1770-4, ffmpeg ebur128) -21 base; okay -21.5, unhappy -22, Theo -21.5, Wren -22, Rocco -20.5 (clamped to -20.5..-22); true peak <= -1 dBTP (actual <= -4.6), no limiting needed. Regenerate = gen_customer_voices.py then normalize_pr20.py.
